guardaxis.problem: Security tools often fail when one source degrades, leaving teams with noisy alerts and weak context during active threat stages.
architecture: FastAPI coordinates detector execution, source scoring, and fallback branches.
React surfaces attack stage, detector confidence, and remediation context.
Docker and GitHub Actions keep local and deployment environments reproducible.
decisions: Use a 4-source threat-scoring engine rather than depending on one detector stream.
Map 14+ detectors across reconnaissance, exploitation, persistence, lateral movement, and exfiltration.
Add multi-layer fallback logic so detector degradation does not cascade through the workflow.
guardaxis.codeSnippet:
async def score_threat(event):
    signals = await detector_pool.run(event)
    confidence = weighted_score(signals)
    return fallback_policy(confidence, signals)

credgen-ai.problem: Loan underwriting becomes slow when credit scoring, anomaly review, and applicant communication happen in separate manual workflows.
architecture: FastAPI orchestrates five agents for intake, scoring, anomaly checks, explanation, and chat response.
XGBoost handles credit scoring while PyOD flags unusual application patterns.
PostgreSQL stores applicant records and Ollama powers natural-language loan queries.
decisions: Separate scoring and anomaly detection so each model remains independently testable.
Treat the chatbot as an explanation layer over structured underwriting state.
Prioritize measurable reductions in manual effort and processing time.

raid-nexus.problem: Ambulance dispatch teams need live incident visibility, fast routing decisions, and explainable fallback behavior when optional AI services are unavailable.
architecture: React command center displays incidents, units, route recommendations, and live status.
FastAPI APIs coordinate dispatch decisions and publish WebSocket updates.
Docker Compose runs the local stack while SQLite demo mode keeps onboarding lightweight.
decisions: Keep deterministic AI fallbacks so dispatch behavior remains explainable.
Preserve local SQLite demo mode while leaving a PostgreSQL production upgrade path.
Use a root start.py flow so the multi-service stack can be launched consistently.

solarai.problem: Solar planning decisions are hard to compare when efficiency prediction, sun-path context, weather, financial analysis, and material scoring live in separate tools.
architecture: Python feature engineering turns site and panel inputs into model-ready signals.
Gradient Boosting predicts solar panel efficiency from engineered features.
Three.js visualises sun path while reporting workflows combine ROI, weather, and material data.
decisions: Use engineered features so the model captures site, weather, and panel context.
Pair prediction with ROI and CO2 reporting so results support practical decisions.
Keep weather and material discovery in the same workflow for richer recommendations.
solarai.codeSnippet:
features = build_solar_features(site, panel, weather)
efficiency = model.predict(features)
report = build_roi_report(efficiency, site)
